## The Globe piece that started this

A recent Boston Globe magazine piece on [homes for sale along Route
20](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/08/07/magazine/homes-route-20-kenmore-watertown/)
featured a condo on Watertown's North Beacon Street — less than a mile
from our house, and on my commuting route to work.

<!-- TODO: the hook. Why a road you drive without thinking about turns out
     to be the same road in five other places you've lived or visited. -->

## Explore the route

::: {#us20-map .column-screen-inset}

Zoom in anywhere along the line. The basemap is OpenStreetMap, so at close range
you get the buildings, side streets, and businesses that actually sit along the
road; switch to Satellite or Topo with the control in the corner.
